citation: Rong S, McDonald JG, Engelking LJ. Cholesterol auxotrophy and intolerance to ezetimibe in mice with SREBP-2 deficiency in the intestine. Journal of Lipid Research. 2017. doi:10.1194/jlr.M077610.
description: Shows in mice that SREBP-2 activates the transcriptional program required for cholesterol biosynthesis and that SREBP-2 deletion reduces intestinal sterol-synthesis genes and sterol synthesis.

citation: Katoh M. Multi-layered prevention and treatment of chronic inflammation, organ fibrosis and cancer associated with canonical WNT/beta-catenin signaling activation. International Journal of Molecular Medicine. 2018. doi:10.3892/ijmm.2018.3689.
description: Reviews APC as a beta-catenin signaling regulator and lists AXIN2 and NKD1 as representative beta-catenin target genes, supporting the expectation that APC loss derepresses canonical Wnt output.

citation: Bell PA, Dennis EP, Hartley CL, Jackson RM, Porter A, Boot-Handford RP, Pirog KA, Briggs MD. Mesencephalic astrocyte-derived neurotropic factor is an important factor in chondrocyte ER homeostasis. Cell Stress & Chaperones. 2018. doi:10.1007/s12192-018-0953-7.
description: Reports that cartilage-specific Manf ablation upregulates ER-resident chaperones including BiP/GRP78, providing a target-specific direction for ER-stress gene induction after MANF loss.

citation: Czermak P, Amman F, Jantsch MF, Cimatti L. Organ-wide profiling in mouse reveals high editing levels of Filamin B mRNA in the musculoskeletal system. RNA Biology. 2018. doi:10.1080/15476286.2018.1480252.
description: Identifies ADAR2 as the enzyme responsible for Filamin B mRNA editing in mouse tissues; this is a specific ADARB1-Flnb bridge but does not establish that Adarb1 loss lowers Flnb abundance.

citation: Tondeleir D, Lambrechts A, Muller M, Jonckheere V, Doll T, Vandamme D, Bakkali K, Waterschoot D, Lemaistre M, Debeir O, Decaestecker C, Hinz B, Staes A, Timmerman E, Colaert N, Gevaert K, Vandekerckhove J, Ampe C. Cells lacking beta-actin are genetically reprogrammed and maintain conditional migratory capacity. Molecular & Cellular Proteomics. 2012. doi:10.1074/mcp.M111.015099.
description: Shows that primary mouse cells lacking beta-actin have compensatory expression of other actin isoforms and broad cytoskeletal reprogramming, supporting ACTG1 induction and a partial bridge to actin-network remodeling.

citation: Aoki M, Fujishita T. Oncogenic Roles of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR Axis. Current Topics in Microbiology and Immunology. 2017. doi:10.1007/82_2017_6.
description: Reviews TSC1/2 as negative regulators of PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling and SREBP as one of the metabolic downstream effectors of mTORC1, providing an indirect bridge from TSC loss to sterol-gene changes.
